question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is "on."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The meaning of the phrase** "look down on someone or something"** means to think of or treat (someone or something) as unimportant or not worthy of respect.
 
• वाक्यांश "look down on someone or something" का अर्थ है (किसी व्यक्ति या चीज़ को) महत्वहीन या सम्मान के योग्य नहीं समझना या उसके साथ व्यवहार करना।
 
 
• **Example**:* The other children **looked down on__** her because her parents were poor.*
 
 
 
• So, the correct answer is Option 1.
 
• Correct paragraph:

It is often said that __if__ you want a pet to look up to you, get a dog. If you want a pet that looks straight __at__ you, get a horse. For an animal that looks down __**on**__ you, the cat must surely ______ (4) _______ this description. Cats are their own bosses. They have little or no regard for anyone or anything. If you have ______ (5) ________ looked closely at the cat, you will observe that it looks at you from the corner of its eyes, almost condescendingly.

1f8:T1846,

The correct answer is "fit."</s
